tools.name: Email Toolbox
tools.description: A lightweight collection of browser-based utilities for everyday email and data-processing tasks.

tools.name: Cheat Sheets
tools.description: A static site. Eighteen cheat sheets are written as Markdown in docs/markdown/ and rendered by Jekyll to /html/<name>.html; the homepage lists every sheet and highlights the four most recently added.

tools.name: Cinder
tools.description: Cinder is a small, standalone front-end code playground: write HTML, CSS and JavaScript in three editors, run the result in a sandboxed live preview, and read console output and runtime errors beside it.

tools.name: Lorem
tools.description: A simple, lightweight, browser-based Lorem Ipsum generator built with HTML5, CSS3, and vanilla JavaScript.

tools.name: Quoted-Printable Decoder
tools.description: A lightweight, browser-based tool for decoding Quoted-Printable encoded email content and rendering the resulting HTML.

tools.name: Linux Nav
tools.description: An interactive educational web application designed to teach Linux filesystem navigation through a visual apartment-complex metaphor.

tools.name: Liquid Prettier
tools.description: A lightweight, browser-based Liquid template beautifier and formatter with specialized support for Braze Liquid tags and personalization syntax.
